caption: The drawing consists of a central symmetrical shape with four extensions, each resembling a branch or leaf-like form, radiating diagonally outward from the center. The entire symmetrical figure is colored solid red. In the middle of the red form, there is a white area shaped like an eight-pointed star or flower, created by the negative space from the inward curves of the red shapes. The composition is centered within a thin, rectangular, gold or brown border on an off-white background. There are no other objects or colors present within the main bordered area. The area outside the border is plain and features some light discoloration and minimal marks.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
